Current state of {entity_id}: {current_state}. Which state counts as "yes"?

Tip: after creating this predictor, you can add helper entities (e.g. school holidays) and tune sampling via the gear icon ("Configure") on its device page.

data.use_recorder_history: Use recorder history as warm start
data.include_target_state_feature: Include the target's own current state as a feature

data_description.include_target_state_feature: Turn this OFF for an anticipatory predictor (e.g. "will there be motion in the bathroom soon" based on a bedroom blind opening) - the target's own current state is usually such a strong predictor of its near future that it can drown out weaker, earlier signals from your helper entities. Keep it ON for a "will this still be true" predictor (e.g. a switch staying on).

error.target_is_helper: The target entity cannot also be a helper entity.
